description: MCP authorization (spec/authorization.md, M1 to M8): the Authorization header and query rules, the 401 and 403 challenges and bodies, the protected-resource metadata URLs and document, the audience comparison, the scope claim, the JWT header and key rules on decoded JSON, the claim rules after the signature, static scope decisions, the batch aggregation of decisions, the principal binding (#532) and the relay input digest (spec/command-metadata.md, "Host-verified confirmation"). Written from the spec, with every expected value computed by Node from the rules as the spec states them; digests are the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON, unpadded base64url. No reference implementation exists yet, so no generator is committed. Signatures, key fetching and introspection are left to each language's suite.
